scenario_summary: The customer is disputing an unrecognized $76 charge on her account and requesting a potential refund.

conversation.message: Hi, my name is Guadalupe Rodriguez and I'm 69. I noticed a $76 charge on my account from two days ago that I don't recognize. I haven't made any recent purchases that I can think of, though it's possible I forgot about something small. Can you look into it, and if it turns out I really didn't authorize it, can you refund it?

Hello Guadalupe, I'm sorry to hear about the confusion regarding that charge. I can certainly help you look into this. To start, could you please provide your account number and the last four digits of your social security number for verification?
Sure, my account number is 88492011 and the last four of my social are 4492.
Thank you. Just to be absolutely sure, can you confirm your full mailing address on file as well?

Thanks. I see the charge here for $76 from 'Global Tech Services'. It doesn't look like a merchant you've shopped with before. Per our standard Terms of Service regarding unauthorized transactions, I need to open a formal dispute for this to be reversed.
Oh, that sounds serious. Does that mean I have to cancel my card?

I'm not entirely sure if you need to cancel it right this second, but I'll go ahead and open the dispute case now. I've initiated the 'Dispute_Unauthorized_Charge' process in our system, which will trigger a temporary credit while we investigate.
Okay, thank you. Will I get an email about this?

Yes, you will receive a confirmation email within 24 hours regarding the dispute case. The temporary credit of $76 has been applied to your account balance as of this moment. Is there anything else I can help you with today?

resolution_summary: The agent verified the customer's identity, confirmed the unrecognized merchant, initiated a formal dispute, and applied a temporary credit to the account.
